import Lean

/-!
Planted by the trust self-test, plant V2-E1 of
`test/contracts/trust-gate-hardening.contract.md`: an axiom added through
`Lean.addDecl`, so that no source token spells it. Only the environment pass
of the gate can see it. Its type is `True`, so nothing false is assumed.
-/

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftCoreM do
  Lean.addDecl (.axiomDecl
    { name := `plantedDeclaredAxiom, levelParams := [], type := Lean.mkConst ``True,
      isUnsafe := false })
